scope: Art-only fall animations for the existing single-loader partisan and Italian gun-crew figures. No extra members or change of game rules.
referenceRecipe: First cell from each accepted 4x4 crew atlas, using its measured fractional geometry and Pillow's rounded crop.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / existing game animation extension. Create SIX progressive non-looping FALL/DEATH frames of the EXACT ONE KNEELING GUN-CREW SOLDIER in the reference. It is one person, not a new squad. Keep exact face, uniform, equipment, camera and body proportions. Crisp dark-outlined chunky low-resolution pixel art for a 60px-tall game sprite, muted palette, no realistic anatomy upgrade or fine texture. Output exactly THREE columns by TWO rows on a true transparent 1536x1024 canvas, cells512x512. Within each cell keep a 480x384 virtual sprite area at x16..495, y64..447, corresponding to a160x128 game frame at3x. A fixed common floor is near cell y430 and root near x256. ONE same anatomical scale throughout, including the fallen pose. Kneeling head top near y85 and knee/boot support near y430. Keep all limbs, headgear and any held item inside its own virtual sprite area without cropping. No floor stripe, shadows, glow, grid, text, numbers, labels, scenery, cannon, muzzle flash, smoke or blood. Pure alpha-zero empty background and opaque sprite pixels only.
Sequence starts in the EXISTING KNEELING WORKING POSE, facing screen RIGHT; do not turn him into a standing rifleman. Frame1: small startled recoil, nearly the original kneel. Frame2: shoulders sag, torso tips forward-right, front leg loses support. Frame3: free hand reaches the ground to brace, hips slide off rear heel and knees fold; keep recognizable body mass. Frame4: hips and side reach floor, upper body lowering, legs stay bent. Frame5: shoulder and head settle close to floor, bent knees and relaxed hands, no bounce. Frame6: final fully motionless side-lying fallen pose, head at right, bent legs at left, face still recognizable and headgear stays on. Body support contacts the same floor in all six cells; body bends rather than a rigid cutout being rotated. Final pose must hold indefinitely. Every pose must be a real progressive movement with consistent hands, not six copies.
REFERENCE IDENTITY: partisan artillery crewman with the DISTINCTIVE THICK BLACK MOUSTACHE, small dark hair under a SOFT DARK-OLIVE PARTISAN CAP (no helmet or beret), dark brown/maroon tunic with black collar and cuffs, brown diagonal shoulder strap, olive trousers, black boots and olive belt pouch. Preserve the exact source cap and moustache in ALL SIX poses. His hands hold the existing LONG OLIVE LOADING TOOL/ARTILLERY ROUND angled up-right; it is NOT a rifle, pistol or grenade. Keep this same item through the start, let it settle beside him when he falls, and show it resting at the end rather than disappearing. Do not add a red armband, helmet, beard, different cap or weapon. Original source's chunky dark outlines and simple face are essential.
